body.name: local joint nonunique proximal bridge chart
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{joint}}(P)=\mathcal L_{\mathrm{out}}(P)\cap\mathcal L_{\mathrm{trt}}(P)\) inside the deliberately restricted bounded likelihood-ratio domain \(\mathcal V_P\). Its admissible paths are every DQM/Hellinger differentiable \(t\mapsto P_t\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{joint}}(P)\) with \(P_0=P\), \(c\le p_t/p\le C\) for sufficiently small \(t\), and \(\sqrt{p_t}=\sqrt p(1+ts/2)+o(t)\) in \(L^2(\nu)\) for some \(s\in L_0^2(P)\). No differentiable bridge representative is included in the definition of a path.
